settings.retryPolicy: At most one retry only for transient transport/service errors; no retry for permanent HTTP, model refusal, malformed output, incomplete output or wrong interpretation. HTTP429 insufficient_quota is permanent. An uncertain transport failure consumes an attempt and full conservative cost reservation.
settings.settingsDepartures: Production sends only model and the exact input prompt, with30s timeout. Evaluation explicitly chooses the requested two models, none reasoning,4096 output limit, Standard/default service tier,store=false,stream=false. Temperature/top_p/text-format/seed/cache overrides are omitted identically. No JSON repair or model-specific tuning.

scoring.semanticAccuracy: All-or-nothing per original response, with field-level reasons also reported. Check ordered canonical geographies, every product/activity pair, no invented sector, annual/explicit=false default, explicit annual/monthly where stated, Ireland exclusion in #6, and gas clarification in #10. Confidence does not award correctness. Canonical names/metadata aliases with the same meaning are accepted; equivalent valid span segmentations are accepted. Contradictory requested/excluded/unresolved dispositions fail semantics even when compatibility fields look correct.
scoring.ambiguityPolicy: Only #10 requires clarification;1–9 establish clear requests and unnecessary clarification fails exact semantic accuracy. #10 must preserve country/consumption, leave product unresolved, and clearly identify natural-gas/gasoline ambiguity rather than guessing; structured ambiguity with equivalent prose is accepted.
scoring.pairsPolicy: Compare canonical ordered pair arrays. Singular compatibility product/activity fields may summarize the first pair; they cannot replace or contradict ordered pairs. #7 must retain both production and consumption. #10 may use an empty pairs array or null-product/consumption pair while clarifying.
scoring.contractCompliance: Strict original JSON only (no fenced/substr JSON repair), prompt-required top-level keys and field/item types, finite0..1 confidences, allowed canonical category values, and exact source evidence validated against original raw text. Record syntactic JSON, shape, and span compliance separately. App built-in tolerant extraction is replayed unchanged and explicitly labelled if it recovers a non-strict answer.
scoring.downstream: Replay every received original response verbatim through interpretQuery with injected transport, validateAiInterpretation (where JSON parses), actual browser appendIntentParams, normalizeSubmittedIntent, public search GET, and cached candidate pipeline. No additional model/EIA calls. Record semantic changes, clarification, fallback, routes, units, frequencies, source coverage, eligible/ranked/displayed counts and candidate IDs. Correct labelled frequency fallback is not itself a model mistake. Empty metadata results and the known Texas routing/eligibility problem are reported separately; no fixes.
scoring.usableInterpretation: Original semantic pass AND JSON/source-evidence contract pass. A downstream rescue/fallback never upgrades model success. Report downstream-safe outcomes separately.
scoring.consistency: For each query/model, compare normalized original semantic signatures from both scheduled repeats; count missing/error repeats as not consistent. Also report strict pass agreement separately. Byte-identical wording/span splits are not required.
scoring.latency: Wall time for each actual attempt. Report median/min/max of successful scheduled generation latency; separately report end-to-end time including retry and failed attempts.
scoring.cost: Use returned input/output/cache-write/cache-hit token usage and official Standard rates. Include all retries with reported usage. For transport failures without usage disclose unknown billed cost and reserve full per-attempt ceiling. Cost per usable interpretation uses all actual known generation cost divided by usable original responses.
scoring.decision: Provisionally prefer Luna only if frozen semantic and contract scores are no worse and measured token cost is lower; if neither is adequate say so. Ten queries and two repeats do not establish statistical equivalence or general complex-negation validity.
